issue_helper.guide.intro: Using this branch name format (`YYYYMMDD_#issue-number_title`) enables the following automatically:
issue_helper.guide.outro: Other branch name formats will not trigger the automation above.
issue_helper.guide.app_build: `@projectops app build` comment build: detects this comment's branch and builds it
issue_helper.guide.test_apk: Test APK build: adds the issue details to the build notes from the branch's `#issue-number`
issue_helper.guide.test_testflight: Test TestFlight build: links the issue details automatically from the branch's `#issue-number`
issue_helper.guide.skills: Commit, report and review skills: extract the issue number from the branch or worktree folder name and complete the commit message and report
